verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a hosted, branded careers page on a customer domain that Ashby publishes to with no engineering work. It only shows developer APIs for building your own careers page, which are developer building blocks that require engineering, the opposite of the story's no-engineering requirement.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: There are 3 main steps to using Ashby's API to create a fully functioning careers page.
If you host your own careers page, you can use this data to populate it.
